plugin.note: Bring dragonfire protection (anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield plus an antifire potion). Green dragons have low defence and die quickly to any strong weapon; Wilderness-viable gear such as Viggora's chainmace or Craw's bow keeps risk low. Keep a one-click escape teleport ready.

requirements: Dragonfire protection (anti-dragon shield / dragonfire shield and an antifire potion)
A one-click teleport for emergency escape
mechanics: Green dragons use melee (slash) and short-ranged dragonfire (max 50 without protection).
Green dragons are weak to water spells (50%).
All Krystilia green dragon kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
Wilderness green dragon spots are popular player-killing areas.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Kill Wilderness green dragons with a fast low-risk weapon and dragonfire protection.
steps: Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
Kill green dragons quickly with a strong melee weapon or ranged.
Watch the minimap for player killers and teleport if threatened.
notes: Green dragons have low defence, so gear choice matters less than speed and survivability.
Bank green dragon bones and hides between trips if desired.

methods.label: Ranged from distance
methods.summary: Range green dragons to avoid melee while keeping dragonfire protection up.
recommendedFor: players who prefer to stay at distance
chipping spawns before other player killers arrive
steps: Keep dragonfire protection active to block the ranged dragonfire.
Attack from distance with Craw's bow or a crossbow.
Move between the clustered Wilderness spawns to maintain kills per trip.
Teleport immediately if a player killer approaches.
notes: Ranged keeps you mobile for a faster Wilderness escape.
Green dragons still deal dragonfire at range, so do not drop antifire.
